calls.statement:
SELECT f.vat_rate, p.vat_class, (f.sale_date >= DATE '2024-09-01') AS after_change, s.store_id >= 900 AS nonstore, f.channel_code,
 count(*) n, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(f.gross_amount) gross, sum(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) vat, sum(round(f.net_amount*f.vat_rate,2)) calc_vat,
 min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dl
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'),
r AS (
 SELECT r.* FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
 WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test')
SELECT 'lines' k, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d, sum(net_amount) net, sum(gross_amount-net_amount) vat, sum(CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) <> sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) datemismatch FROM l
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns', count(*), count(DISTINCT return_line_id), sum(refund_net), sum(refund_gross-refund_net), 0 FROM r
UNION ALL SELECT 'rpt', sum(receipts), 0, sum(net_sales_before_returns), sum(returns_net), count(DISTINCT business_date) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND store_id<900

WITH s AS (
 SELECT f.vat_rate, sum(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat_charged
 FROM fact_sales_line f
 JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
   AND st.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
 GROUP BY 1),
r AS (
 SELECT x.vat_rate, sum(x.refund_gross - x.refund_net) AS vat_refunded
 FROM fact_return_line x
 JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = x.store_key
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = x.product_key
 WHERE x.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
   AND st.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT 'FY2024/25' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, CAST(s.vat_rate*100 AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS vat_rate_pct, s.vat_charged, r.vat_refunded
FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING (vat_rate) ORDER BY s.vat_rate
